provenance.driver_path: tools/shim-probe/shim-probe.cpp (GPL checkout, never copied into fn64)
provenance.note: A fact about one black-box run. Carries no runtime code and describes no runtime internals.

observations.reason: The reference call terminates the driver process on SIGBUS (exit 138) from a bare context. Driving it needs the runtime's timer manager stood up first, which this black-box driver does not do. Isolated: the same script's osCreateMesgQueue and osRecvMesg calls run to completion in the same process, so the trap is osSetTimer's own requirement and not a broken script or a dead link.

The reference call terminates the driver process on SIGSEGV (exit 139) from a bare context, measured with osPiStartDma as the only call in the script. Driving it needs the runtime's PI manager stood up first. No completion-message timing was observed, so fn64's PI completion ordering is unverified against the reference by this harness.
